previous_autonomous_wave.result: Added bounded, fail-closed interactive continuity evidence across AW33 reconstruction generations and AW34 seek/loop semantics; physical Apple/device/audio evidence remained open.

latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Eliminate unbounded historical retention from delayed Task-cancellation delivery in the unified transport authority while preserving true pre-enqueue cancellation and all AW34 transport ordering semantics.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: The cancellation handler returns to the actor through a separate Task. The prior fallback inserted any ticket that was no longer pending or executing into cancellationBeforeEnqueue, so a cancellation delivered after completion or supersession created a marker that could never be consumed. Long interactive cancellation/completion races could therefore grow retained state monotonically.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: Only tickets explicitly inside a live admission window can create a pre-enqueue cancellation marker; that marker is consumed or abandoned with the same admission; pending and executing cancellation semantics remain unchanged; retired late delivery is counted but not retained; snapshot exposes machine-checkable admission invariants; one-million-event stress ends with zero retained markers; AW34 fixed-window/barrier/recovery semantics remain unchanged; Apple/device/PARITY claims remain disabled.
latest_autonomous_wave.result: COMPLETE_NON_PARITY: added Lane3UnifiedCancellationAdmissionFence and wired continuous/discrete authority admission through it. Late cancellation for retired tickets is telemetry-only instead of future cancellation state. Strict portable self-test passed. One-million-event stress processed 200000 true pre-enqueue cancellations and 400000 late-retired cancellations with zero retained admission tickets/markers and zero invariant violations. Optimized 20 x 1000000 bookkeeping benchmark: median 44.723ms, p95 50.038ms, max 53.359ms, checksum 5000192. Authority diff preserves AW34 fixed-window and transport execution semantics. Complete selected Xcode/Apple actor race, physical iPhone, real audio/current-Moises differential/listening and PARITY remain open.
